name: Stut Rtch
description: FAUST 3s SDRAM stutter & random ratchet looper (UNLATCH=retro grab, LATCH=auto transient) with random SRR/BRR, driven analog LPF, and clean HPF.

params.name: Slice
params.explanation: Base stutter slice length on an exponential curve (25 ms to 2,000 ms).

params.name: Ratch
params.explanation: Random ratchet subdivision depth (0 = steady 1x loop, 100 = wide random 1/2x..8x jumps & scatter).

params.name: RndMd
params.explanation: When random sources re-roll Ratchet, SRR, and BRR: on STOMP, every SLICE wrap, or BOTH.

params.name: SRR
params.explanation: Random Sample Rate Reduction ceiling (0 = off / 44.1 kHz, 100 = random ZOH down to ~1.5 kHz).

params.name: BRR
params.explanation: Random Bit Rate Reduction ceiling (0 = off, 100 = random bitcrushing down to ~2.5-bit).

params.name: LPF
params.explanation: Driven emulated analog 2-pole resonant LPF cutoff (350 Hz warm dub to 16 kHz open).

params.name: HPF
params.explanation: Clean undriven 2-pole Butterworth HPF cutoff after LPF (0 = off, 1..100 = 40 Hz to 3.5 kHz).

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Stutter wet output level (80 is unity at nominal MS-70CDR+ bus level).

params.name: Mix
params.explanation: Dry vs. stutter wet crossfade when active (0..100%).

params.name: ON/OFF
params.explanation: LATCH: normal toggle. UNLATCH: momentary while held.
